page_title: FIO 5-1 SAS | Fiorentina v Sassuolo 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' The match has just finished.
88' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
87' Fiorentina are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
84' One of the players from Fiorentina times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
84' Fiorentina earn a corner.
83' It is time for a substitution. Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina) is on for Riccardo Sottil.
81' The referee blows his whistle after Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
80' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Arthur Melo and he is replaced by Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina).
80' Yellow card. Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
79' A long cross into the middle of the area is pounced on by Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo), but his header curls narrowly wide of the right post.
77' Matteo Marcenaro couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) and blew his whistle.
75' A lofted pass into the box is met by Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina), who rifles a shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
75' The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.
73' Daniel Boloca goes off the pitch and Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo) comes on.
72' The cross fools the defence and leaves Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just over the bar.
71' Here is a change. Christian Kouame is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) will replace Lucas Martinez Quarta.
70' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
70' The linesman raises his flag. Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) is adjudged offside.
70' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fiorentina.
70' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fiorentina.
69' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom left corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Andrea Consigli. What a save!
69' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
67' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.
66' 5 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Antonin Barak finds Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 5:1.
64' Davide Ballardini prepares a substitution. Pedro Obiang is replaced by Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo).
64' Substitution. Ruan Tressoldi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Filippo Missori (Sassuolo).
62' 4 - 1 Goal! Riccardo Sottil tees up Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 4:1.
61' Corner kicks – 7:2.

58' 3 - 1 Riccardo Sottil sends a superb cross into the box. Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the bottom right corner, leaving Andrea Consigli beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:1.
57' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Josh Doig tees up Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) inside the box and he slams the ball into the roof of the net and past Oliver Christensen.

54' 2 - 0 Goal! Arthur Melo hands Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
54' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
54' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
53' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marcenaro interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

52' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Andrea Consigli, who pulls off a stunning save!

51' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
51' Fiorentina quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
49' Wasted opportunity. Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
49' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
49' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has made a change at the break. Nicolas Gonzalez has come on in place of Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
46' Half-time substitution. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is replaced by Nedim Bajrami.
46' Davide Ballardini has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Samuele Mulattieri comes on the pitch for Mattia Viti (Sassuolo).
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
44' A quickly taken corner by Fiorentina.

44' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Andrea Consigli pulls off an easy save.
41' 4:1 – the corner kicks stats.
40' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina), whose header goes wide of the goal.
39' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matteo Marcenaro saw the whole situation.
37' Fiorentina hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
37' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
36' A pass into the box finds Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Andrea Consigli denies him.
35' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.

33' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
32' It must be a yellow card. It is. Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
30' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
29' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
27' Matteo Marcenaro has a clear sight and sees a foul from Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo).
26' 74:26 – the latest ball possession ratio.

24' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
24' Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.

20' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
17' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
14' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
14' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
13' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
13' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
12' The game is interrupted. Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
12' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
11' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' The free kick from long range, taken by Fiorentina, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Dangerous play by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo). Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Andrea Consigli comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for an infringement.
7' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
6' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
6' Fiorentina players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
3' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
2' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
2' Andrea Consigli leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina).
